'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**The [[economy of New Zealand]] enters a [[recession]] after [[gross domestic product]] fell 0.1% in the March quarter, as the [[Reserve Bank of New Zealand|central bank]] raises [[interest rate]]s to a 14-year high. Annual growth also slowed to 2.2%, according to [[Statistics New Zealand]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-first-quarter-gdp-shrinks-01-country-now-technical-recession-2023-06-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Carberry highway collision]]
**Fifteen people are killed and ten more injured in a collision between a semi-trailer truck and a bus on [[Manitoba Highway 1]] near [[Carberry, Manitoba|Carberry]], [[Manitoba]], [[Canada]]. [https://winnipeg.ctvnews.ca/at-least-15-killed-in-crash-on-trans-canada-highway-in-manitoba-sources-1.6442629 (CTV News Winnipeg)]
*Eighteen people are injured in an explosion at a [[firecracker]] warehouse in [[Bocaue]], [[Bulacan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/873009/18-slightly-hurt-in-bocaue-bulacan-fire/story/ (GMA News)]
*Three people are killed and more than 50 others are injured by a tornado in [[Perryton, Texas|Perryton]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/devastating-tornado-tears-texas-town-3-dead-50/story?id=100103004 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Russia relations]]
**[[Australian Prime Minister]] [[Anthony Albanese]] announces that the [[Parliament of Australia|parliament]] will pass a law to prohibit the construction of a new [[Embassy of Russia, Canberra|Russian embassy]] in [[Canberra]] due to national security concerns regarding the embassy's proposed location adjacent to [[Parliament House, Canberra|Parliament House]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/15/australia-blocks-new-russian-embassy-near-parliament-in-canberra (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Commons Privileges Committee investigation into Boris Johnson]], [[Partygate]]
**An inquiry by the [[United Kingdom|UK]] [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] concludes that former [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] lied to Parliament about breaking rules during the [[COVID-19]] outbreak in [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom|the country]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/uk-politics-65876914 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 in archosaur paleontology]]
**Researchers from the [[Natural History Museum, London|Natural History Museum]] in [[London]], United Kingdom, [[List of dinosaur finds in the United Kingdom|discover]] the [[fossil]]s of a [[herbivorous]] dinosaur species named ''[[Vectipelta|Vectipelta barretti]]'' on the [[Isle of Wight]]. The [[ankylosaur]], with "blade-like spiked armor", is the first of its kind found on the island in 142 years and will be added to the collection at [[Dinosaur Isle]] for public display during the summer. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/new-dinosaur-species-discovered-uk-isle-of-wight-vectipelta-barretti-ankylosaurus/ (CBS News)]
